subject.title: fix(gateway): cap sessions.get when numeric limit is huge

question: Should the public `sessions.get` RPC silently cap oversized finite numeric limits at 1000 for existing clients?
rationale: The cap protects the Gateway from excessive transcript scans but deliberately reduces the result size for callers that previously requested more than 1000 messages, and the response does not expose cap metadata.

options.title: Adopt the 1000 cap
options.body: Confirm bounded history as the public contract, then require a clean rebase and live Gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve larger requests
options.body: Keep the existing behavior or introduce an explicitly documented pagination or opt-in mechanism instead of silently truncating existing requests.

recommendation.title: Adopt the 1000 cap
recommendation.body: Confirm bounded history as the public contract, then require a clean rebase and live Gateway proof before merge.
